description: Commission a specific human after agreeing on terms, deadline and completion criteria. Pass fundingMethod: wallet with a stable idempotencyKey to reserve existing wallet funds including fees; insufficient_wallet_funds returns required/available/shortfall cents without checkout or auto-top-up. Retry the same key for the same hire; changed inputs or a new hire need a new key. Omit fundingMethod for a hosted checkout. Funding does not complete work or pay the worker. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.
